command:
python - <<'PY'
from experiment.geometric_reconstruction_summary import _select_configs, run_summary
configs = _select_configs(topologies=['ffc'], per_class=1000)
configs += _select_configs(topologies=['fjh'], per_class=10)
run_summary(configs=configs, base_dir='results/reconstruction_audit_reproducible_2026-10-10', seed=20261010)
PY
seed_rule: run_summary uses base seed + configuration index: ffc=20261010, fjh=20261011.
selection_rule: Enumerate the complete symmetry-distinct assignment pool, classify by stabilizer stratum (High/Med/Low), sort each stratum by structure ID, and sample up to 10 IDs uniformly without replacement using random.Random(seed). For ffc, per_class=1000 exceeds all stratum sizes, so every representative is included.
dft: No DFT calculation is part of this structural audit.
